description: This file appears to be a C source file implementing configuration management functions for wpa_supplicant, including creating, loading, saving, adding, deleting, and accessing configuration parameters stored in maps. It handles file I/O, string parsing, and map manipulations related to wpa_supplicant configuration data.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_createConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t ** conf)
methods.description: Creates a new wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure, initializing global and network maps.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_loadConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t ** conf,char * path)
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file into a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure, parsing key-value pairs and handling global/network sections.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_deleteConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Deletes a wld_wpaSupp_config_t structure, cleaning up internal maps and freeing memory.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_writeConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,char * path)
methods.description: Writes the configuration data from the structure into a specified file, using a temporary file and rename operation for integrity.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_addConfigParam(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,const char * key,const char * value,bool isGlobal)
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in either the global or network section of the configuration.

methods.name: bool wld_wpaSupp_delConfigParam(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf,char * key)
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the configuration, searching both global and network maps.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_wpaSupp_getGlobalConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the global configuration map.

methods.name: swl_mapChar_t * wld_wpaSupp_getNetworkConfig(wld_wpaSupp_config_t * conf)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the network configuration map.
